name: n8r-researcher
description: Research software components and configuration from source evidence using the AI Surface Model. Experimental working notes; no deployment or compatibility claims.

interface.longDescription: Investigate supplied repositories or documents with the current AI harness. Keep source evidence, configuration choices, uncertainty and user decisions in portable working notes. This experimental skill does not run the target system or produce validated n8r research/Surface artefacts. Source access and saving depend on the host's available tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: Research the components and configuration in the supplied sources, with evidence and open questions.
